name: @types/ws
purpose: TypeScript declarations for the ws WebSocket transport used by the standalone multiplayer server.
licenseEvidence: npm registry metadata from `pnpm view @types/ws@8.18.1 license repository.url time --json` reported MIT and https://github.com/DefinitelyTyped/DefinitelyTyped.git.
wellKnownEvidence: DefinitelyTyped is the established source of TypeScript declarations for libraries that do not ship declarations; this package is build-time-only and pins the declarations matching ws major version 8.
